√dhyā 'think'
present: [4.] dhyā́yati etc. B.+ dhyā́yate etc. E.+ dhyāyīta -- [2.] dhyāti etc. B.+ dhyāyāt 
perfect: dadhyau etc. B.+ 
aorist: [4.] dhyāsus -- [6.] ádhyāsiṣam 
future: [1.] dhyāsyati -- [2.] dhyātā 
verbal: dhyāta B.+ dhyātvā B.+ -dhyāya E.+ dhyāyam 
secondary: passive: dhyāyate -- intensive: dādhyā- -- desiderative: didhyāsate -- causative: dhyāpayati 
derivatives: dhyā́ V.+ -dhyāyin B.+ dhyāna U.+ dhyātavya C. dhyātṛ C. dhyeya E.+ -didhyāsana C. -didhyāsitavyà B. -didhyāsu C. 
Compare √dhī, of which this is a later secondary form.
